provenance.evidence: values read from lm15-python@365cbca lm15/login/flows/*.py and lm15/auth.py; native live observations in lm15-python docs/cookbooks/21-managed-login-live.md; changes/2026-09-24-managed-auth-profiles-and-browser-track.md §1, §3, §4

about: Provider login profiles for managed authentication (spec/auth-managed.md AUTH-13, AUTH-18, AUTH-26). One entry per provider route an SDK can sign in to, one method per way of signing in. Every value is what lm15-python sends today and, where stated, what was observed live. This file is a wire-fact record under AUTHORITY.md: live provider behavior beats it, provider documentation beats it, and it beats any SDK. An SDK copies these values and a test compares them; an SDK never becomes the source of a client id, URL or scope. Nothing here is a secret: client ids are public registrations of native or CLI apps.

conventions.placeholders: <client_id>, <redirect_uri>, <scope>, <state>, <code>, <verifier>, <challenge>, <device_code>, <user_code>, <device_auth_id>, <refresh>, <github_token>, <identity_token>, <domain>, <host>, <callback_url> are filled per attempt. Every other string is sent verbatim.
conventions.encoding: form = application/x-www-form-urlencoded body; json = application/json body; query = URL query of a navigation (never fetched by the SDK).
conventions.headers: Every auth exchange sends Accept: application/json. Where the platform allows it, the User-Agent is lm15/<version> unless the profile names another (AUTH-18 identification, changes/2026-09-24-managed-auth-profiles-and-browser-track.md). Browsers do not let a page set User-Agent; that is a platform limit, recorded in browser.json, not a profile deviation.
conventions.pkce: S256 always (RFC 7636). verifier_bytes is the count of random bytes base64url-encoded without padding: 64 bytes give 86 characters, 32 bytes give 43.
conventions.state: state_bytes random bytes, encoded as stated (base64url or hex). state is independent of the PKCE verifier.
conventions.material: The private shape saved per provider in the store (store-layout.md). oauth = {type, access, refresh?, expires (epoch ms, actual), issued_at (epoch ms), lifetime_s}; api_key = {type, key, minted?}.
conventions.evidence: native = lm15-python on a workstation. Dates are when a person observed the step live; the redacted notebook is lm15-python docs/cookbooks/21-managed-login-live.md (commit 365cbca). Browser evidence is kept separately in browser.json.
